title: Scheduling Administrator
description:
Scheduling Administrator 7017

Location: Cirencester
Hours: Monday to Friday, Full Time - 8.30 am to 5 pm Permanent
Salary: 28,000 - 30,000

Our client is looking for a highly organised Scheduling Administrator to join their busy team. This is a varied role coordinating engineers, managing schedules and ensuring work is completed efficiently while delivering excellent customer service.

title: Client Administrator (Gloucester)
description:
The Opportunity
An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced IFA Administrator to join a highly regarded national financial planning business with an excellent reputation in the market, located in Gloucester.

Working closely with a team of Financial Advisers, you'll provide high-quality administrative support across the full client journey, ensuring new business, client requests and ongoing transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

title: Business Support Administrator
description:
Business Support Administrator 7033
Location: Dursley, Gloucestershire
Hours: Full Time Permanent Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm
Salary: 28,000 - 30,000 per annum

Our client is looking for an organised and proactive Business Support Officer to provide administrative, compliance and operational support across the business. This is a varied position covering general business administration, compliance, health & safety, documentation and operational support, working closely with different departments and external providers.

Key Responsibilities of a Business Support Administrator:
- Provide administrative and operational support across the business
- Maintain accurate compliance records, documentation and internal systems
- Monitor relevant regulatory and industry requirements and keep internal teams updated
- Complete and maintain supplier and customer compliance documentation
- Maintain product information, commodity codes, export descriptions and supporting records
- Liaise with external Health & Safety advisers and coordinate agreed actions
- Maintain COSHH documentation including Safety Data Sheets and associated records
- Support the preparation and collation of documentation for ISO audits
- Provide day-to-day GDPR administration and maintain accurate records
- Support the annual insurance renewal process and coordinate required information
- Maintain accurate paperwork, electronic filing and confidential records
- Support the Managing Director and Operations Manager with administration, research and ad-hoc projects
- Work with other departments to ensure documentation and actions are completed on time
- Provide administrative and operational cover across the wider business when required
- Arrange pallet bookings and obtain freight quotations
- Check freight invoices and liaise with suppliers regarding warehouse requirements
- Support import, export and regulatory documentation
- Generate and process customer invoices accurately and on time
- Verify order information and supporting documentation prior to invoicing

Key Skills of a Business Support Administrator:
- Previous experience within a busy office-based administration, business support or compliance role
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Confident communicating with colleagues, customers, suppliers and external providers
- Good numeracy and literacy skills
- Strong IT skills including Microsoft Office
- Ability to learn and confidently use internal business systems
- Proactive and dependable approach to work
- Comfortable researching information and escalating queries where appropriate
- Experience with ISO, Health & Safety administration, GDPR, import/export documentation or compliance would be advantageous

To be considered for this Business Support Administrator role please contact Katie Tyrrell at First Base Employment.

title: Operations Administrator
description:
Join a Growing International Business

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an organised, proactive and commercially aware individual to join a successful and growing international business operating within the global manufacturing and automotive supply chain sector. This is far more than a traditional administration role.

- Produce reports and monitor KPIs.
- Build professional customer and supplier relationships.
- Support quality control, compliance and supplier performance monitoring.

title: Receptionist
description: As a GP Receptionist at Yorkleigh Surgery, which is part of the Inspire Healthcare group, you will be the first point of contact for our patients, providing a professional, friendly and efficient service both in person and over the telephone. You will play an important role in ensuring patients receive a positive experience and are directed to the most appropriate care and support. You will be responsible for managing appointment bookings, responding to patient enquiries face to face, online and by telephone, and providing appropriate information and signposting to other services where required. The role involves handling a high volume of telephone calls, welcoming and assisting patients at reception, processing requests and undertaking a wide range of administrative duties. You will be required to record information accurately on clinical systems and ensure that patient information is handled with confidentiality, professionalism and care. You will work closely with GPs, nurses, healthcare professionals and the wider practice team to support the smooth and effective day-to-day running of the practice and contribute to the delivery of high-quality patient care. This is a varied and rewarding role which requires excellent communication and organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to remain calm, courteous and professional in a busy and sometimes challenging healthcare environment. Warm, friendly and approachable, with a genuine desire to help people. A confident communicator who can build positive relationships with patients and colleagues. Organised and proactive, with the ability to manage a busy and varied workload. Calm, professional and resilient, particularly when dealing with challenging situations. A good team player who is happy to support colleagues and contribute to the wider practice. Confident using technology and willing to embrace new digital ways of working. Accurate and attentive to detail, particularly when recording information on clinical systems. Able to use initiative, think on your feet and find solutions to help patients. Committed to maintaining confidentiality and treating every patient with dignity and respect. Experience in general practice or healthcare is desirable, but attitude is just as important as experience. If you are enthusiastic, compassionate and keen to develop your career in primary care, we would love to hear from you. Greet patients warmly and assist them with the check-in process. Manage appointment scheduling and confirmations, ensuring an organised calendar for healthcare providers. Answer phone calls promptly, addressing patient inquiries and directing calls to appropriate personnel. Maintain accurate patient records and ensure confidentiality in accordance with data protection regulations. Collaborate with medical staff to ensure smooth operations within the practice. Keep the reception area tidy and organised, creating a pleasant environment for patients.
